CASE WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' AND T.SLLR_USR_SN = #{usrSn} THEN '구매자' WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' AND T.BYPR_USR_SN = #{usrSn} THEN '판매자' WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' AND T.REQ_USR_SN = #{usrSn} THEN '제공자' WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' AND T.PRV_USR_SN = #{usrSn} THEN '요청자' END
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TRD_SN, MAX(TRD_STS_HST_REG_DT) AS completedDate FROM TRADE_STATUS_HIST WHERE TRD_STS_HST_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0006' GROUP BY TRD_SN ) completedHist ON completedHist.TRD_SN = T.TRD_SN

/* 리뷰(임시): 작성 가능한 거래 목록 - TRADE 읽기 전용 조회, 상단 주석 참고 */ SELECT T.TRD_SN AS id, P.PRD_SN AS productId, T.TRD_SN AS tradeId, CASE WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' THEN 'goods' ELSE 'service' END AS dealType, AS partyLabel, U.USR_NM AS partyName, CASE WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' THEN P.PRD_NM ELSE S.SVC_REQ_TTL END AS title, DATE_FORMAT(completedHist.completedDate, '%Y-%m-%d') AS completedDate, AS counterpartUsrSn, CASE WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' AND T.REQ_USR_SN = #{usrSn} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS counterpartServiceProvider FROM TRADE T LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' AND P.PRD_SN = T.PRD_SN LEFT JOIN SERVICE_REQUEST S ON T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' AND S.SVC_REQ_SN = T.SVC_REQ_SN LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USR_SN =
WHERE T.TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0006' AND (T.SLLR_USR_SN = #{usrSn} OR T.BYPR_USR_SN = #{usrSn} OR T.REQ_USR_SN = #{usrSn} OR T.PRV_USR_SN = #{usrSn}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM REVIEW R WHERE R.TRD_SN = T.TRD_SN AND R.REVWR_USR_SN = #{usrSn} ) ORDER BY T.TRD_UPDT_DT DESC LIMIT 100

/* 리뷰(임시): 작성 가능 여부 재검증(단건) - TRADE 읽기 전용 조회, 상단 주석 참고 */ SELECT T.TRD_SN AS id, P.PRD_SN AS productId, T.TRD_SN AS tradeId, CASE WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' THEN 'goods' ELSE 'service' END AS dealType, AS partyLabel, U.USR_NM AS partyName, CASE WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' THEN P.PRD_NM ELSE S.SVC_REQ_TTL END AS title, DATE_FORMAT(completedHist.completedDate, '%Y-%m-%d') AS completedDate, AS counterpartUsrSn, CASE WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' AND T.REQ_USR_SN = #{usrSn} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS counterpartServiceProvider FROM TRADE T LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' AND P.PRD_SN = T.PRD_SN LEFT JOIN SERVICE_REQUEST S ON T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' AND S.SVC_REQ_SN = T.SVC_REQ_SN LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USR_SN =
WHERE T.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND T.TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0006' AND (T.SLLR_USR_SN = #{usrSn} OR T.BYPR_USR_SN = #{usrSn} OR T.REQ_USR_SN = #{usrSn} OR T.PRV_USR_SN = #{usrSn}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM REVIEW R WHERE R.TRD_SN = T.TRD_SN AND R.REVWR_USR_SN = #{usrSn} )

/* 리뷰: 내가 작성한 리뷰 목록 (TRADE 조인 부분은 임시, 상단 주석 참고) */ SELECT R.RVW_SN AS id, R.RVW_SN AS reviewId, P.PRD_SN AS productId, R.TRD_SN AS tradeId, R.RVW_SCORE AS rating, R.RVW_CN AS content, CASE WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' THEN 'goods' ELSE 'service' END AS dealType, CASE WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' THEN P.PRD_NM ELSE S.SVC_REQ_TTL END AS title, CASE WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' AND T.SLLR_USR_SN = #{usrSn} THEN '구매자' WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' AND T.BYPR_USR_SN = #{usrSn} THEN '판매자' WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' AND T.REQ_USR_SN = #{usrSn} THEN '제공자' WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' AND T.PRV_USR_SN = #{usrSn} THEN '요청자' END AS partyLabel, U.USR_NM AS partyName, DATE_FORMAT(completedHist.completedDate, '%Y-%m-%d') AS completedDate FROM REVIEW R JOIN TRADE T ON T.TRD_SN = R.TRD_SN LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' AND P.PRD_SN = T.PRD_SN LEFT JOIN SERVICE_REQUEST S ON T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' AND S.SVC_REQ_SN = T.SVC_REQ_SN JOIN USERS U ON U.USR_SN = R.REVWD_USR_SN
WHERE R.REVWR_USR_SN = #{usrSn} AND R.RVW_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY R.RVW_REG_DT DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT T.TRD_SN AS tradeId, T.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatusCode, R.RVW_SN AS reviewId, R.RVW_USE_YN AS reviewUseYn, R.RVW_SCORE AS rating, R.RVW_CN AS content FROM TRADE T LEFT JOIN REVIEW R ON R.TRD_SN = T.TRD_SN AND R.REVWR_USR_SN = #{usrSn} WHERE T.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND (T.SLLR_USR_SN = #{usrSn} OR T.BYPR_USR_SN = #{usrSn} OR T.REQ_USR_SN = #{usrSn} OR T.PRV_USR_SN = #{usrSn})

SELECT T.TRD_SN AS tradeId, T.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatusCode, R.RVW_SN AS reviewId, R.RVW_USE_YN AS reviewUseYn, R.RVW_SCORE AS rating, R.RVW_CN AS content FROM TRADE T LEFT JOIN REVIEW R ON R.TRD_SN = T.TRD_SN AND R.REVWD_USR_SN = #{usrSn} WHERE T.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND (T.SLLR_USR_SN = #{usrSn} OR T.BYPR_USR_SN = #{usrSn} OR T.REQ_USR_SN = #{usrSn} OR T.PRV_USR_SN = #{usrSn})

SELECT R.RVW_SN AS reviewId, R.TRD_SN AS tradeId, T.PRD_SN AS productId FROM REVIEW R JOIN TRADE T ON T.TRD_SN = R.TRD_SN AND T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' WHERE R.RVW_SN = #{reviewId} AND R.REVWR_USR_SN = #{usrSn} AND R.RVW_USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT R.REVWD_USR_SN AS receiverUserSn, R.RVW_DOMAIN_CD AS domainCode, CASE WHEN R.RVW_DOMAIN_CD = 'RVWC0002' AND T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' AND T.PRV_USR_SN = R.REVWD_USR_SN THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS receivedAsServiceProvider FROM REVIEW R JOIN TRADE T ON T.TRD_SN = R.TRD_SN WHERE R.RVW_SN = #{rvwSn} AND R.REVWR_USR_SN = #{usrSn} AND R.RVW_USE_YN = 'Y'

/* 리뷰: 신뢰지표 집계 (F-COM-009~010) */ SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(R.RVW_SCORE), 1) AS totalScore, COUNT(CASE WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' THEN 1 END) AS goodsCount, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' THEN R.RVW_SCORE END), 1) AS goodsScore, COUNT(CASE WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' THEN 1 END) AS serviceCount, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' THEN R.RVW_SCORE END), 1) AS serviceScore FROM REVIEW R JOIN TRADE T ON T.TRD_SN = R.TRD_SN WHERE R.REVWD_USR_SN = #{usrSn} AND R.RVW_USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(R.RVW_SCORE), 1), 0.0) AS averageScore, COUNT(*) AS reviewCount FROM REVIEW R JOIN TRADE T ON T.TRD_SN = R.TRD_SN WHERE R.REVWD_USR_SN = #{usrSn} AND R.RVW_DOMAIN_CD = 'RVWC0002' AND R.RVW_USE_YN = 'Y' AND T.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' AND R.REVWR_USR_SN = T.REQ_USR_SN AND T.PRV_USR_SN = R.REVWD_USR_SN
